values.note: 57 back-in drive-in sites in four campgrounds: Anglers 16, Birch 16, Ridge 14, Lady's Slipper 11. ReserveMN pads run 20-60 ft; the DNR's RV length limit is 50 ft, and large fifth wheels and RVs are advised not to go past Ridge Campground (narrow roads, no turnarounds, small sites).

note: Rustic sites in four wooded campgrounds near Zippel Bay on Lake of the Woods, with over two miles of sand beach, a marina and a fishing pier. Lady's Slipper is the closest to the beach (about a quarter mile); Anglers sits apart, about 1.7 km west, off the marina road. --Claude
